worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.summary: Lay a short-lived quicksand pit on a reachable patch of aimed ground: fine sand cracks open as a warning, then the pit opens and grit churns toward its centre. Only a grounded enemy whose feet stand on that surface is dragged in - slowing from light to a full hold over about 12 ticks, drawn toward the centre every beat and ground once every interval. Rising off the ground, stepping past the rim or losing the ground all break free at once; stepping back in sinks you again from the start. It can be pre-placed on empty ground, and fliers or airborne foes are unaffected. The deep style lasts longer and sticks harder but grinds softer; the snare style grinds harder, pulls in sooner and ends sooner.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.use.0: Turn a patch of ground into a pit ahead of time to deny movement
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.use.1: Drag a heavy grounded target toward the centre
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.use.2: Wear down a bulky target with physical damage over time
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.use.3: Make jumping or flying the foe's only choice
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.description.0: The pit is about %1$s blocks across and can open on reachable ground within %2$s blocks; the %3$s wind-up cracks the sand first, and a grounded target is held fully after about %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.description.1: A grounded target in the pit is ground every %2$s for about %1$s physical damage; each beat draws it %3$s blocks toward the centre; the pit lasts %4$s, and leaving the ground or the rim frees it at once.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.option.on: Deep style on: duration x1.15, radius x1.2, pull x1.2, cooldown +8, but grind x0.9 - a deeper pit buries the target longer.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.option.off: Deep style off (snare): shorter duration and smaller radius, pulls in sooner and shorter cooldown, but full grind - it ends sooner.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.timing: Castable on reachable ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; recover %3$s, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.growth.0: At level %1$s the grind power rises to %2$s and the pull strength to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.preference.de: On: duration x1.15, radius x1.2, pull x1.2, cooldown +8, but grind x0.9 - a deeper pit buries the target longer. Off: grinds harder, pulls in sooner and ends sooner.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.preference.ai: Only consider quicksand on a threat within this distance; lower it to collapse a pit only up close, raise it to trap from farther away.
On: only collapse a pit under a grounded threat and skip airborne foes (no quicksand there, saving the cast); off: willing to try on any threat in range, and an airborne foe will be missed.
